subject.title: Native Anthropic path: replaying historical `thinking` blocks bricks long tool-use threads (`Invalid signature in thinking block` 400)

question: Which linked Anthropic replay fix should be treated as canonical for this issue's completed-turn native Anthropic replay failure?
rationale: The bug is well-supported, but current open PRs split the solution between provider-converter replay policy, latest-slot sanitation, and broader session-history guards; that boundary affects provider compatibility and should be maintainer-owned.

options.title: Use the scoped replay-policy PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 as the primary completed-turn native Anthropic replay candidate, then evaluate other PRs only for leftover latest-slot or sanitizer gaps.

options.title: Adopt a broader sanitizer guard
options.body: Sponsor a broader sanitizer or pre-send guard such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100149 if maintainers want invalid signatures removed before provider conversion across more surfaces.

options.title: Keep the umbrella unresolved
options.body: Keep this issue open while reviewing the recovery-carrier and replay-policy PRs together if maintainers want one coordinated cluster decision.

recommendation.title: Use the scoped replay-policy PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 as the primary completed-turn native Anthropic replay candidate, then evaluate other PRs only for leftover latest-slot or sanitizer gaps.
